observations: Three photos show a black electronic keyboard with 61 keys, placed on artificial green grass.
The keyboard has a central control panel with multiple buttons, sliders, and knobs, including 'MIDI Module', 'Auto Bass Chord', and 'Chord Synth' sections.
The keys appear to be standard white and black, with some visible wear or smudges, especially on the right side.
The brand 'YAMAHA' is visible on the top right of the keyboard in photo 0 and photo 2.
The model name 'P-100' is visible on the bottom left of the keyboard in photo 0 and photo 2.
The keyboard has two speaker grilles on either side of the control panel.
The seller claims it is for children and includes an adapter, but no adapter is visible in any photo.
The keyboard shows signs of use: minor scuffs, dirt, and possible keyboard damage on the right side in photo 0.

claims.claim: Quality and good Yamaha keyboard for children
claims.evidence: The brand and model are confirmed, but 'quality' and 'good for children' are subjective and not verifiable from photos alone. No child-friendly features or safety certifications are visible.
No video or photo shows the keyboard powered on or keys being played. Functionality cannot be confirmed remotely.
No adapter is visible in any photo. The seller's claim cannot be confirmed without seeing it.

claims.claim: Bought from the UK, no dead key, no crackle.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
